name: Easy Slow Cooker "Cincinnati Chili" with Noodles & Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add onion, garlic, beef, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb lean ground beef
3 tbsp chili powder
2 tsp pumpkin spice mix
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer ground beef and any cooking juices to a 6-quart slow cooker insert. Add tomatoes, broth, beans (do not drain), cocoa powder, and Worcestershire, then stir to combine. Cover and cook until flavors have blended, LOW for 4-5 hours or HIGH for about 2 hours. (The chili will be soupy.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 (15 oz) can kidney beans
2 tbsp cocoa powder
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the flavors have blended, break lasagna noodles into 2-inch pieces and add to the slow cooker. Stir to combine and continue to cook until noodles are tender, 1 hour more.
To serve, divide chili between bowls. Top with cheddar and enjoy!
